pr_body:
This PR fixes an issue with producing synthetic source when fields that need to be synthesized using ignored source are indexed multiple times in one document. Previously multiple ignored source values were not handled and this PR introduces logic to merge them together into a single field value.

Closes #111694.
pr_title: Merge multiple ignored source entires for the same field
